facts.fact: 周三早上 Willow Creek 认定 Marigold Ranch 重新有意思：Carson 还没走完 Main Street 第一个街区，就被三个多年没说过话的人挥手打招呼。
facts.anchor: three people I had barely spoken to in years had waved at me before I made it through the first block of Main Street

facts.fact: 有人把一张手写便条塞在 Meme 的 Camry 挡风玻璃雨刷下，主动提出为南瓜地做志愿者，而 Marigold 根本没有南瓜地。
facts.anchor: someone had left a handwritten note beneath the windshield wiper of Meme’s Camry offering to volunteer for the pumpkin patch

facts.fact: Rosie 让 Carson 在敲定供应商合同前核对数量，June 要 Marigold 为几个节日供应商供奶；Clover 坚持 Carson 亲自到 Sugar and Pine 来取表格。
facts.anchor: June wanted Marigold to supply milk for several festival vendors, and Rosie had asked me to review quantities before she finalized vendor contracts

facts.fact: 节日订单：三家供应商要瓶装全脂奶，一家要奶油，Sugar and Pine 两样都要，一家本地咖啡公司要足够连办两天季节饮品摊的奶量。
facts.anchor: Three vendors wanted bottled whole milk. One wanted cream. Sugar and Pine wanted both. A local coffee company wanted enough milk to run a seasonal drink tent for two days

facts.fact: Clover 向 Carson 自述：当过两年啦啦队且很讨厌，因为觉得十七岁必须谈恋爱，和 Travis 交往了八个月。
facts.anchor: Dated a guy named Travis for eight months because I thought being seventeen meant relationships were a must

facts.fact: Clover 因为 Hunter 买的商店饼干是她见过最难吃的，开始亲自给他带饼干。
facts.anchor: So I started bringing him cookies because he bought the worst store-bought ones

facts.fact: 面包店里 Hunter 摘下假肢递给 Clover，Clover 把它小心放到柜台下，继续像没事一样和他聊天。
facts.anchor: He detached the prosthesis, handed it to Clover, and rubbed the end of his residual limb through the thin liner beneath his shirt sleeve

facts.fact: Beau 通过短信约 Carson 出去；两人最终定在周五 7 点，Beau 坚持 Friday. 7. I’m picking you up. 亲自接她。
